senses.gloss:
1. अर्ज् अर्ज्, i. 1, and 10, Par. To earn, to acquire, MBh. 11, 193; Indr. 3, 7 (Ātm.).
 स्व-अर्जित and स्वयम्-अर्जित, adj. Acquired by one's own efforts, Rām. 1, 43, 11; Man. 9, 209.
 --With the prep. उप उप, To acquire, Man. 9, 208.

2. अर्ज् अर्ज्, i. 10, Par. To work, to prepare.
 --With the prepositions समुप सम्-उप, To prepare, Chr. 14, 21 (read तत् तु).
अर्जन अर्ज् + अन, n. Earning, acquisition, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 219.

अर्जुन अर्ज्-उन (from a lost vb. akin to राज्).
 I. adj., f. नी, White, Chr. 288, 3 = Rigv. i. 49, 3.
 II. m.
 1. A tree, Terminalia Arjuna, Rām. 3, 19, 13.
 2. The name of the third son of Pāṇḍu, Indr. 1, 10.
 III. f. नी, The dawn, Rām. 2, 114, 14.
 --Cf. ἀργεννός, ἄργυρος; Lat. argentum; the base of these forms is अर्ज् + वन्त्: cf. also ἀργός, ἄργιλος, ἀργής, Ἀργυννίς; see रञ्ज्, रजत.

आर्जव आर्जव, i. e. ऋजु + अ, n. Candour, [] Man. 11, 222; Bhartṛ. 2, 19.
 --Comp.
आर्जुनेय आर्जुनेय, i. e. अर्जुन + एय, patronym. m. A descendant of Arjuna (?), Chr. 298, 23 = Rigv. i. 112, 23.
